chunks: Zurārah narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
Regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic,
He عليه السلام said: "Shawwāl, Dhū al-Qaʿdah, and Dhū al-Ḥijjah. It is not for anyone to enter ihram for hajj in other than them."

key_terms.أَشْهُرٌ: months; the designated time period for the rite
key_terms.الْحَجُّ: the pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.ذُو الْحِجَّةِ: the third of the hajj months
key_terms.ذُو الْقَعْدَةِ: the second of the hajj months
key_terms.شَوَّالٌ: the first of the hajj months
key_terms.يُحْرِمَ: to enter into ihram for pilgrimage

ai.seo_question: Which months are the well-known months of hajj in Qur'an 2:197?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic phrase about the well-known months of hajj as Shawwāl, Dhū al-Qaʿdah, and Dhū al-Ḥijjah. It establishes the legal ruling that ihram for hajj is only to be entered during these specified months.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2959 - Zurara narrated from Abu Ja'far (as)
regarding the words of Allah (swt), the Exalted:
(Surah Al-Baqarah 2:197). Imam (as) said: "Shawwal, Dhu al-Qa'dah, and Dhu al-Hijjah. No one is permitted to enter Ihram for Hajj outside of these months."
